professionalSummary.text: Has operated at staff level, setting technical direction across more than one team.
professionalSummary.witness: Staff Software Engineer for the observability platform of a cloud software company since 2022, setting the platform's technical direction across its ingestion, storage and query teams; senior software engineer on the storage team from 2018 to 2022.

experienceHighlights.text: Has written the technical strategy and the architecture decision records that other teams build against.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the platform's technical strategy for 2023 and 2025 and the fourteen architecture decision records the three teams built against, all under my name in the platform's architecture repository.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Chairs a design review and represents a platform in a technical steering group.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Chaired the platform design review from 2022, with the review calendar and the review outcomes in the repository, and represented the platform in the company's technical steering group, where the steering group minutes record the platform items under my name.

skills.text: Coaches senior engineers under a documented coaching practice.
skills.witness: Coached the five senior engineers across the three teams under the engineering coaching practice, with the coaching agreements filed with the engineering managers.
